figures.caption: Figure 1. JWST galaxies at 3 < z < 9 (points, coloured by redshift) overlaid on the SDSS z ≈0 relations (black). Left: the star-forming main sequence; high-z galaxies sit above the local sequence as observed. This offset is not corrected for emission- line selection, which biases the detected population upward at fixed mass (§3.1); below z ≈6 the offset is consistent with pure selection. Right: the mass–metallicity relation; high-z galaxies lie below the local relation with large scatter. The metallicity deficit is a differential the emission-line selection does not manufacture and is the more robust of the two signals.
